# hivelocity_vps (Data Source)

Looks up a VPS instance by `device_id`, or by filtering the instance list (for example on `facility_code` or `status`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By device ID
data "hivelocity_vps" "app" {
  device_id = 12345
}

# By filtering the instance list
data "hivelocity_vps" "tampa" {
  first = true
  filter {
    name   = "facility_code"
    values = ["TPA1"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (Number) Device ID of the instance.
- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_init` (String) Cloud-init script in effect.
- `facility_code` (String) Facility.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `iso_id` (String) Attached ISO, if any.
- `memory` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `nics` (List of Object) Network interfaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nics))
- `ssh_key_ids` (List of Number) Authorized SSH key IDs.
- `status` (String) Instance status.
- `template_id` (String) Template used for the install.
- `vcpu` (Number) Number of vCPUs.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
